Ethics and Integrity

At Adobe, good business begins with our commitment to the highest ethical standards. We adhere to the following core principles:

Integrity
, by conducting business according to high ethical standards

Respect
for our employees, customers, vendors, partners, stockholders and the communities in which we work and live

Honesty
in our internal and external communications and all business transactions

Quality
in our products and services, striving to deliver the highest value to our customers and partners

Responsibility
for our words and actions, confirming our commitment to do what we say

Fairness
through adherence to applicable laws, regulations, policies and a high standard of behavior

We encourage you to read our policies to learn more about the legal and ethical standards we embrace.

Political disclosures
We believe public policy engagement is an important and appropriate role for companies when conducted in a legal and transparent manner. Adobe is committed to participating in the political process in compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and reporting requirements. Our policies and procedures for political contributions made with corporate funds are set forth in the
Public Policy and Government Relations Policy
. Learn more about our
government relations involvement
.

Corporate political contributions
Under U.S. law, corporations are not allowed to contribute money to federal candidate committees, party committees and political action committees. Many U.S. states allow corporate donations to state and local candidates or ballot issue campaigns. On a limited basis, Adobe may make corporate political contributions to support candidates and ballot measures that align with our public policy agenda and business interests and are in compliance with the
Public Policy and Government Relations Policy
. As part of our policy, we prohibit "soft money" contributions to any groups organized under section 527 of the Internal Revenue Code.

No Political Action Committee
Adobe has not established a federal or state Political Action Committee (PAC).

Trade associations
Adobe belongs to several
trade associations
that require the payment of regular dues. Some of our trade associations may use a portion of the dues collected for political expenditures. Interested parties should contact the trade associations directly to obtain information on how much they spend on political expenditures.

title: Explorations
text:
Explorations

#000000

Innovating beyond our day‐to‐day.

Our culture of exploration inspires creative thinking, effective problem solving and one-of-a-kind programs that make things work better throughout our business and within our communities.

Transforming the employee experience.

In 2012, we replaced underperforming annual performance reviews with ongoing Check-in conversations between employees and their managers. The result? Voluntary attrition dropped and morale soared as employees felt more nurtured and managers felt more empowered. And now, we've open-sourced our tools and resources so other companies can start Check-in programs of their own.

Learn more about Check-in ›

Empowering creative individuals.

At Adobe, we think creative visual content is essential to human culture. So in 2015, we established the Adobe Creative Residency — a program that gives two talented artists the opportunity to focus on a personal creative project for one year, and to share their work and discoveries with the creative community.

Learn about the Creative Residency program ›

Unleashing innovation.

A six-step innovation process that comes packaged in a bright red box, Adobe Kickbox helps individual employees develop ideas for new products and services. When word got around, Adobe open-sourced Kickbox for any company to use.

Read about it in Fortune ›

A window into Adobe Labs.

Sneaks demonstrations are insider peeks at the ideas and technologies percolating inside Adobe Labs. Get a closer look at the people and technology behind Adobe Sneaks.

Check out Peek Behind the Sneaks ›

Interactive 3D Face Stylization Using Sculptural Abstraction

. Jachnik, J., Goldman, D., Luo, L., Davison, A. (Feb 6, 2015)

Doing our research.

The people who are part of Adobe Research explore and invent technologies that amaze and delight. Their breakthroughs today shape the experiences of tomorrow.

Explore Adobe Research ›

A passion for invention.

As Adobe’s cofounders often say, “Good ideas come from everywhere in the company.” Jeff Chien, senior principal scientist and one of our many employee inventors, has developed 51 patents that have made Adobe Photoshop the powerhouse image editor it is today.

Learn about Jeff’s patents ›

title: PDF specification
text:
PDF specification

PDF Specifications

PDF is one of the most popular file formats in use today. PDF files specify the appearance of pages in a document in a reliable and device-independent manner, which is highly desirable to authors looking to deliver a predictable experience for readers of their documents.

PDF History

PDF was initially defined and made available as a specification in 1993. At this time, page content was represented as an image and there was no mechanism for users with disabilities to access the page content unless they could see it visually.

Version 1.3 of the PDF specification in 2000 introduced features that enabled an underlying logical structure to exist for a PDF document. In version 1.4 (2001) the concept of “tagged PDF” was added to the specification, which enabled users of assistive technologies such as Window-Eyes and JAWS to present document content to users without vision. Tagged PDF also enabled other accessibility features in PDF viewers including text reflowing to allow users to increase text size without needing to scroll horizontally. Subsequent versions of the PDF specification included additional features such as the addition of form controls, and included support for accessibility as the features were introduced.

With version 1.7, Adobe released control of the PDF specification to ISO, and in July 2008 ISO 32000-1:2008 was released as an International Standard.

Is PDF Accessible?

Support for PDF accessibility dates back to 2001.

The PDF specification provides robust support for accessibility. The accessibility of any individual PDF file depends upon how well the author prepared the file for accessibility, and the accessibility of the experience for the end user depends on how well the PDF viewer application supports the accessibility features in the specification.

Adobe Reader takes advantage of all attributes of PDF files that have been properly prepared for accessibility. Familiar accessibility features found in formats like HTML such as alternative text for images, semantic elements to convey relationships and structure, labels for form controls, headings for tabular data, and a meaningful and logical content sequence are all fully supported by the PDF specification. Users of popular assistive technologies such as NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, ZoomText, SuperNova, MAGic, and more are able to use their tool of choice and access information contained in PDF files.

In addition to support by assistive technologies, Adobe Reader also provides support for critical accessibility features such as text enlargement, text reflow, high-contrast viewing, as well as providing rich support for keyboard-only access for users who are unable to use a mouse.

An
Overview of PDF Accessibility
is available which provides general information about features of PDF which support accessibility.

Are all PDF files accessible?

PDF files can be created in many ways, and not all ways produce accessible files. Many PDF documents are created with scanners and cannot be regarded as accessible without substantial work. Other files may be created with lower-quality tools which do not provide support for PDF tags necessary for proper accessibility support.

Files created with many common tools, including Microsoft Word, OpenOffice Writer, Adobe InDesign, and Adobe Acrobat (to name just a few) do support accessibility well. Even these tools require that the author create the document with accessibility as a goal – information such as image equivalents and logical structure types needed to properly represent the content of the document must be added by the author and verified to be appropriate.

Authors who use tools that support the accessibility features of the PDF format and who follow best practices for authoring accessible PDF documents make highly accessible documents.

PDF Standards

ISO 32000-1:2008, the International Standard for PDF. Since 2008, PDF is an open standard, not controlled by any single organization.

Document Management – Portable Document Format – Part 1: PDF 1.7, First Edition

Adobe-hosted version of the original ISO 320000 specification
, available free of charge.

PDF/UA – PDF/Universal Accessibility is the common name for ISO 14289-1. PDF/UA provides requirements for PDF documents, viewers, and assistive technologies to ensure that accessibility is properly supported.

Document management applications -- Electronic document file format enhancement for accessibility -- Part 1: Use of ISO 32000-1 (PDF/UA-1)

WCAG 2.0 (ISO 40500:2012) – WCAG 2.0 is the
W3C’s Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.0
, also an ISO standard. WCAG 2.0 is implemented into legal policies around the world, including in Europe, Australia, Canada, the United State, and more. PDF documents can meet WCAG 2.0 to the Priority AA level, and the WCAG Working Group provides a
set of techniques which are helpful to authors looking to create accessible PDF
that conforms to this standard.

WCAG 2.0 Techniques for PDF

Section 508 – The Rehabilitation Act of 1973 includes the Section 508 amendments which are the technical standards that apply to US Government procurement and development. The current Section 508 rules are based on WCAG 1.0, and well-authored PDF documents can meet these technical standards. Section 508 is currently being refreshed and it is expected that the next version of the technical standards will be based on WCAG 2.0.

What does PDF mean?

PDF is an abbreviation that stands for Portable Document Format. It's a versatile file format created by Adobe that gives people an easy, reliable way to present and exchange documents — regardless of the software, hardware, or operating systems being used by anyone who views them.

The PDF format is now an open standard, maintained by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). PDF docs can contain links and buttons, form fields, audio, video, and business logic. They can be signed electronically and can easily be viewed on Windows or macOS using Adobe Acrobat Reader.

Adobe created the PDF.

In 1991, Adobe co-founder Dr. John Warnock launched the paper-to-digital revolution with an idea he called The Camelot Project. The goal was to enable anyone to capture documents from any application, send electronic versions of these documents anywhere, and view and print them on any machine. By 1992, The Camelot Project had developed into PDF. Today, the PDF is a file format used and trusted by businesses around the world.

PDF document conversion made easy.

Warnock’s vision continues to shape the way we work. When you create an Adobe PDF from documents or images, it looks just the way you intended it. While many PDFs are simply pictures of pages, Adobe PDFs preserve all the data in the original file format — even when text, graphics, spreadsheets, and more are combined in a single file.

PDF features that help you work smarter.

What are the differences between the Acrobat for teams and Acrobat for enterprise plans?

Acrobat for teams plans are designed for small and midsize teams that need full-feature PDF and e-signature solutions.

Acrobat for enterprise plans are designed for large organizations with complex needs. They’re best for customers that need full-feature PDF solutions with enterprise-level control and management — with or without embedded e-signature capabilities.

What’s the difference between Acrobat Pro and Acrobat Studio?

Acrobat Pro delivers powerful tools for working with PDFs and creating and managing e-signatures. Acrobat Studio is our most advanced Acrobat offering, bringing together productivity and creativity tools in a secure, all-in-one solution. It includes everything in Acrobat Pro as well as Acrobat AI Assistant and PDF Spaces to unlock insights across documents plus Adobe Express Premium, the app that makes content creation quick and easy for everyone in your organization. What do I get with the business plan that I don’t get with an individual plan?

Frequently asked questions

How do I download and install my free trial version of Acrobat Pro?

After clicking “Start free trial” from this web page, you will be asked to provide your email address. If you already have an Adobe ID you’ll be asked to sign in. Otherwise follow steps to start your free trial.

When does the free trial period officially begin?

The free trial period begins on the day you sign up. At the end of the free trial period, your payment method will be charged unless you cancel. Cancel before your free trial ends and you won't be charged. When the free trial expires, you can still use Acrobat to view PDFs, comment and fill forms. To access premium features again, you will need to purchase Acrobat.

I have an older version of Acrobat installed on my computer. What will happen to it if I install the free trial version of Acrobat Pro?

Installation of Adobe Acrobat Pro free trial by default uninstalls any earlier version of Adobe Acrobat on Windows devices. If you choose to retain the existing Acrobat software on your machine, change the default by unchecking the “Remove earlier version” option in Acrobat downloader UI. If you have uninstalled the previous version, then you can reinstall it when you are finished with the trial. Make sure you have your original serial number and installation files.

Does it work for both Windows and Mac OS? (System Requirements)

What is Adobe Scan?

Adobe Scan is a mobile app that can scan paper documents, forms, and images and convert them into high-quality PDFs that can be shared, searched, edited, and more.

What kind of documents can I scan?

With Adobe Scan, you can scan documents, receipts, handwritten notes, drawings, and images and quickly convert them into a PDF.

How do I convert an image into a PDF?

Open Adobe Scan and point your camera at the document you want to turn into a PDF. Adobe Scan will capture an image and automatically save it as a high-quality PDF.

How can I scan physical documents into PDFs?

The Adobe Scan mobile app turns your phone into a scanner. Simply open the app and point your camera at your paper document. Adobe Scan will capture an image of your physical document and convert it into a high-quality PDF that can be opened, viewed, and shared in Acrobat Reader.

Can I scan multiple pages into one PDF?

Yes, you can scan multiple pages in one session and combine them into a single PDF. Adobe Scan also features a high-speed scan mode that makes it easy to bulk scan a large number of pages in seconds.

Does Adobe Scan recognize text?

Yes. Adobe Scan features Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to make scanned text searchable and editable.

Are the Adobe Scan and Acrobat Reader apps free for mobile devices?

Questions? We have answers.

What is Adobe Acrobat Reader?

Adobe Acrobat Reader is the free, trusted app for viewing, annotating, and signing PDF documents on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android. It's the world's most widely used PDF reader, with over 500 million installs globally. It opens PDFs exactly as they were designed, preserving fonts, layouts, and embedded content. Acrobat Reader is free to download and use without a subscription.

Can Adobe Acrobat Reader edit PDFs?

Adobe Acrobat Reader lets you add comments, highlights, sticky notes, and free-text annotations to PDFs. You can also fill out and save PDF forms. Text and image editing is not available in Acrobat Reader and requires an Adobe Acrobat Standard or Adobe Acrobat Pro subscription.

How do I sign a PDF for free with Adobe Acrobat Reader?

In Adobe Acrobat Reader, open your PDF, click “Sign” in the toolbar, and draw, type, or upload an image of your signature. You can place the signature anywhere in the document and save the signed file for free.

Can I sign documents and forms electronically with Acrobat Reader?

Yes. The Fill & Sign tool, powered by Adobe Acrobat Sign, makes it easy to sign documents and forms. Just open any PDF file, sign by typing or drawing your signature, or using an image.

Using the Adobe Acrobat Reader mobile app, you can do the same tasks on your iOS or Android devices too. To download the Adobe Acrobat Reader mobile app, visit
Google Play
or the
Apple App Store
. You can also fill and sign forms using your web browser.

What commenting tools are available in Acrobat Reader?

Reader makes it easy to annotate PDF documents. With Reader on your desktop, you can: annotate PDFs using sticky notes; type text directly onto the page; highlight, underline, or use strikethrough tools; and draw on the screen with the freehand drawing tool. The same commenting tools are also available in Acrobat Reader for mobile.

Can I fill out and save forms with Acrobat Reader?

Yes. The Fill & Sign tool automatically recognizes whether your PDF has fillable form fields or not and takes you to an intuitive filling experience, powered by Adobe Sensei, to get the job done quickly and easily. With a fillable form, it’s easy to type your answers or select from drop-down lists, then save your completed form. When working with simple PDFs that haven’t been optimized with form fields, you can click anywhere and type answers right onto the form – or you can accept suggestions from your personal autofill collection. When you’re done, you can save your changes and send the completed form to others.

Using the Adobe Acrobat Reader mobile app, you can do the same tasks on your iOS or Android devices too. To download the Adobe Acrobat Reader mobile app, visit
Google Play
or the
Apple App Store
.

Who is Adobe Acrobat Reader best for?

Adobe Acrobat Reader is best for individuals who primarily need to view, print, and lightly annotate PDFs — without the need for complex editing tools. It includes the Adobe Acrobat Reader mobile app, the go-to tool for students and office workers looking to fill out forms, sign documents, and review content on the go.

Is Adobe Acrobat Reader safe and trustworthy?

Yes, Adobe Acrobat Reader is developed by Adobe, the company that created the PDF standard over 30 years ago. It is one of the most widely trusted PDF viewers in the world. Acrobat Reader includes built-in security features and releases regular security updates to protect your documents against new vulnerabilities.

What operating systems does Adobe Acrobat Reader support?

Adobe Acrobat Reader is available for Windows 10 and 11, macOS 10.15 (Catalina) and later, iOS 16 and later, and Android 8.0 and later. It also works in web browsers via the Adobe Acrobat web app for quick PDF access without installation.

How does Adobe Acrobat Reader differ from Adobe Acrobat Pro?

Adobe Acrobat Reader is free and includes basic tools to view, annotate, fill out forms, and sign documents. Adobe Acrobat Pro includes additional advanced tools to edit text and images, create and convert PDFs, send and track unlimited e-signatures, compress files, and secure your documents. The upgrade from Acrobat Reader to Acrobat Pro unlocks a complete document workflow platform.

Student Spaces FAQs

What are Student Spaces?

Student Spaces is an
AI-powered study hub
in Adobe Acrobat that helps you understand, organize, and learn from your materials. Upload your files, ask questions, and create study tools without jumping between apps or tabs. You can access Student Spaces on Acrobat web from any mobile or desktop browser.

How does Student Spaces help me study smarter?

Student Spaces turns your class materials into interactive study tools like flashcards, quizzes, study guides, mind maps, videos, and podcasts. You can chat with an AI tutor, take notes, and keep everything for a topic together so studying feels simpler and more focused.

What can I create in Student Spaces?

You can upload up to 100 files of 600 pages or fewer and generate tools such as flashcards, practice quizzes, study guides, study packets, presentations, videos, podcasts, and mind maps, so you can learn in the way that works best for you.

Is Student Spaces free for students?

Yes. Student Spaces is free for students for a limited time with fair-use limits on standard study tools. Premium tools, like podcasts, presentations, and video summaries, are available when you create a free personal Adobe account.

Can I trust the AI responses?

When you upload documents or links, AI-generated answers and study tools include clear citations. You can click any citation to see exactly where the information came from, so you stay in control of what you learn. While we always strive for accuracy across our tools, please be sure to double-check your responses for accuracy. For more information, please learn more about our
generative AI user guidelines
.

Can I collaborate with classmates?

Absolutely. You can share a Student Space with classmates or friends and choose their access level, so you can review notes, study tools, and materials together in one shared space.

Adobe for All.

Adobe for All is our belief in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Our founding principle is that great ideas come from anywhere and when people are respected and included, they are more creative, innovative and successful. The wealth of unique perspectives and experiences that our employees bring is vital to our business growth, fueling the product innovation and value that we deliver to billions of people around the world.

“Adobe’s unwavering focus on people, purpose, and community has guided our evolution and growth for over four decades and inspires our employees to make an impact and invent the future. As one of the world’s most innovative software companies whose products touch billions of people around the world, we are committed to serving the diverse needs of our customers and making a positive impact in their lives.”

John & Chuck's legacy shines through in our values.

Our founders John Warnock and Chuck Geschke established a company culture where employees could do their best work and be themselves, and great ideas would be welcomed from anywhere in the organization. More than 40 years after our founding, their vision continues to be reflected in
Adobe’s values and culture
.

Our company values.

As we look to the future, our values represent the attributes and actions that will help get us there, underscoring what is powerful about our heritage and what will define our future success.

Empowering our employees to make an impact.

At Adobe, we offer fair compensation, wellbeing benefits and a culture of belonging, so everyone can thrive both personally and professionally.

Advancing fair pay practices.

As part of our belief in Adobe for All, we want every employee to feel they have fair compensation and opportunity. We invest in analysis, transparency and processes and strive to reward employees with compensation that is market competitive. And we review pay twice a year as part of our rewards review process.

Supporting wellbeing.

At Adobe, your health and wellbeing matters. That’s why we offer a range of inclusive benefits designed to support you and your family in staying healthy — physically, mentally, and financially. From health insurance to wellbeing reimbursements, employee assistance programs, and work-life support, we’ve got you covered with our comprehensive
benefits programs
.

Building belonging.

Fostering an inspiring and vibrant workplace is core to Adobe, and our employee networks, site councils, and community impact teams run events and programs to build community. Our annual Adobe for All event harnesses the power of storytelling to amplify and celebrate the link between our Adobe for All belief and the uniqueness of our people, purpose and products.

Acrobat. حل المستندات الأساسي، أينما تذهب.

راقب مستنداتك باستخدام ميزات قوية للجهاز المكتبي والجوال والويب.

تمتع بتحرير النصوص والصور داخل Acrobat مباشرةً.

أصلح النص وبدِّل الصور بسهولة دون الانتقال إلى تطبيق آخر. فكل ما تحتاج إليه هو بضع نقرات.

معرفة المزيد | معرفة المزيد حول تعديل ملفات PDF

أنشئ ملفات PDF من أنواع ملفات أخرى.

الصور. شرائح PowerPoint. جداول البيانات. مستندات Word. تمتع بتحويل ملفك إلى ملف PDF يمكنك مشاركته مع أي شخص بسهولة.

معرفة المزيد | معرفة المزيد حول إنشاء ملفات PDF

وقِّع إلكترونيًا واطلب التوقيعات.

وقِّع المستندات أو اطلب التوقيعات على أي جهاز، بما في ذلك الجوال. لا يتعين على المستلمين تسجيل الدخول.

معرفة المزيد | معرفة المزيد حول توقيع ملفات PDF يمكن تعبئتها

استكشف المزيد من ميزات Acrobat.

المشاركة والمراجعة.

أرسِل ملفات PDF إلى أي شخص باستخدام الميزة Share (مشاركة)؛ مع العِلم أنك لست بحاجة إلى تسجيل الدخول لعرض ملف PDF لديك أو التعليق عليه.

حدد الاختلاف.

استخدم الأداة Compare Files (مقارنة الملفات) لمعرفة التغييرات بين إصداري PDF بسرعة وسهولة.

حافظ على أمان ملفات PDF.

امنع الآخرين من نسخ محتوى PDF لديك أو تحريره أو طباعته باستخدام الميزة Protect PDF (حماية ملفات PDF).

Robison Home Builders هي شركة مقاولات تمتلكها وتديرها عائلة في يوتاه وقد ظهرت مؤخرًا ضمن أفضل 40 شركة يديرها مقاولون بعمر أقل من 40 عامًا في الولايات المتحدة. تعرّف على المساعدة التي يقدمها Acrobat لهم في تنظيم الخطط عبر عدة مواقع أعمال ومقاولين.

معرفة المزيد | معرفة المزيد حول المساعدة التي يقدمها Acrobat لمؤسسة Robison Home Builders في تنظيم الخطط عبر عدة مواقع عمل ومقاولين.

الاستفادة من التقنية بغرض النمو.

تحولت شركة J. Morey Company، وهي شركة تأمين مقرها في لوس أنجلوس ذات قيم رائعة، بالكامل إلى Acrobat منذ عامين. اكتشف طريقتها في استخدام Acrobat بغرض تنمية إرث العائلة وزيادة تأثير أعمالها.

هل لديك استفسارات؟ لدينا الإجابات.

ما هو Adobe Acrobat؟

Acrobat هو حل PDF لتحقيق الإنتاجية والتعاون الذي يشمل برنامج Acrobat للجهاز المكتبي وأدوات Acrobat عبر الإنترنت وتطبيق Acrobat Reader للجوال وتطبيق Adobe Scan؛ حيث يتوفر كل هذا لتتمكن من العمل بأمان وفعالية من أي مكان وباستخدام أي جهاز.

ما الفرق بين Acrobat Standard وAcrobat Pro؟

يشمل Acrobat Standard ميزات PDF الأساسية؛ مما يسمح لك بإجراء ما يلي:

تحرير ملفات PDF وتنظيمها

تحويل المستندات إلى PDF والعكس

ملء النماذج وتوقيع المستندات وطلب التوقيعات الإلكترونية

حماية الملفات بكلمة مرور

يتضمن Acrobat Pro كل الميزات المتوفرة في Acrobat Standard، هذا بالإضافة إلى إمكانات PDF المتقدمة والتوقيع الإلكتروني. باستخدام هذه الميزات المتقدمة، يمكنك تنفيذ ما يلي:

تحرير ملفات PDF وتنظيمها

تحويل المستندات الممسوحة ضوئيًا إلى مستندات PDF قابلة للتحرير والبحث بها

مقارنة ملفات PDF لمراجعة الاختلافات

إخفاء المعلومات الحساسة من ملفات PDF

إضافة العلامة التجارية إلى اتفاقياتك عبر إضافة شعار وعنوان URL مخصص

تصميم نماذج الويب وقوالب التوقيع الإلكتروني القابلة لإعادة الاستخدام

تحصيل المدفوعات باستخدام
Braintree
حيثما أمكن

استلام التوقيعات الإلكترونية المتعددة وتتبعها بإرسالها بشكل مجمع

يمكنك الاطلاع على مقارنة بين
Acrobat Standard أو Acrobat Pro
وغيره من عروض Acrobat.

ما الذي يتضمنه اشتراكي في Acrobat؟

يشمل اشتراكك في Acrobat برنامج الجهاز المكتبي والوصول عبر الإنترنت وتطبيقات الجوال، مما يتيح لك مزامنة ملفاتك بسهولة عبر أجهزة الكمبيوتر والأجهزة.

برنامج Acrobat Pro أو Acrobat Standard للجهاز المكتبي:
استخدم أدوات Acrobat على جهازك المكتبي، بما في ذلك ميزات التحويل والتحرير والحماية المتقدمة. يمكنك أيضًا دمج Acrobat مع أدوات الإنتاجية الأخرى أو العمل دون اتصال بالإنترنت.

Acrobat عبر الإنترنت:
استخدم أدوات PDF والتوقيع الإلكتروني على أي متصفح ويب. تساهم ميزات التكامل المضمنة مسبقًا التي نقدمها لكل من Microsoft وOneDrive وGoogle Drive وغيرها في تيسير مهام تخزين الملفات ومشاركتها عبر الإنترنت. حتى إنه يمكنك إرسال المستندات للتوقيع الإلكتروني وتتبع الاستجابات بشكل فوري.

تطبيق Acrobat Reader للجوال:
يزخر هذا التطبيق المجاني، الذي يثق به مئات الملايين، بأحدث الأدوات التي تحتاج إليها لمواصلة العمل على مشروعاتك حيثما تكون.

تطبيق Acrobat Scan للجوال:
استخدم هذا التطبيق المجاني في
مسح المستندات ضوئيًا وتحويلها إلى ملفات PDF
والتعرف على النصوص تلقائيًا لتحريرها.

هل يتضمن Adobe أدوات لمساعدة أقسام تقنية المعلومات في عمليات النشر في المؤسسات؟

نعم، يتوفر الكثير من أدوات Acrobat وأدواته المساعدة لتسهيل عمليات التوزيع في المؤسسة والمساعدة في التحكم في تكاليف تكنولوجيا المعلومات. لمعرفة المزيد، تفضل بزيارة
صفحة موارد تكنولوجيا المعلومات
.

ما الحد الأدنى لمتطلبات النظام لتشغيل Acrobat؟

راجع
صفحة متطلبات النظام لبرنامج Acrobat
للحصول على المعلومات.

ما اللغات التي يتوفر بها Acrobat؟

راجع
صفحة متطلبات النظام لبرنامج Acrobat
للحصول على المعلومات.

هل برنامج Adobe Document Cloud آمن؟

نعم، يمثل أمان تجربتك الرقمية أولوية قصوى لدينا في Adobe، سواء أكان يرتبط هذا بإدارة الهوية أو سرية البيانات أو سلامة المستندات. حيث تستعين Adobe بممارسات أمنية قياسية في هذا المجال لحماية مستنداتك وبياناتك ومعلومات الشخصية. للحصول على معلومات إضافية حول الممارسات الأمنية، أو دورة حياة منتج Adobe Secure، أو أمان حل Adobe Document Cloud، راجع
صفحة الأمان لدينا.

شركتي مهتمة بشراء Acrobat بشكلٍ جماعي. كيف أبدأ؟

إذا كانت لديك شركة وتحتاج إلى إدارة بضع تراخيص فقط بين المستخدمين، فقد يكون اشتراك Acrobat للفِرق خيارًا مناسبًا ويمكن شراؤه مباشرةً. بالنسبة للمؤسسات والشركات الأكبر التي لديها احتياجات إدارية ونشر أكثر تعقيدًا، تتوفر لدينا خيارات الترخيص المجمع التي يمكن الاختيار من بينها.
اطلب اتصالاً من إدارة مبيعات Adobe Enterprise
، أو اتصل ببائع تجزئة معتمد من Adobe.

Frequently asked questions

What is the Adobe Affiliate Program?

The Adobe Affiliate Program is a referral program that allows you to monetize your website and social media channels by promoting Adobe products and earning a commission for each qualified sale.

How does it work?

Approved partners in the program can post banners and text links or create custom links to content that directs their visitors to the Adobe website. When that visitor makes a qualified purchase within a 30-day period, the publisher is eligible for a commission to the sale.

Is there a cost to join?

There is no fee required to sign up in the program.

Is there a minimum audience size to be approved as an Affiliate?

No. Adobe recognizes the value of partners with smaller audiences that are a great fit for Adobe.

How do I join the program?

Sign up
here.

Accept the terms and conditions to join the Partnerize network. Once you‘re on the network, request to add the Adobe campaign to your account.

Who is Partnerize and why do I need to join this Network?

Partnerize is a global platform and services provider Adobe has retained to manage the Affiliate program. Partnerize teams support and grow businesses through enablement, a content portal, tracking, dashboards, and payment of commissions.

Why can’t I add the Adobe campaign directly to my Partnerize account?

Currently, Adobe is reviewing applications for the program prior to approval.

Where do I find information on setting up my Affiliate account?

You will receive a welcome email from Partnerize with links to several support tools, including a video demo, Getting Started guide, and instructions for setting up links, payments, and more.

In addition to the tools in your Getting Started guide, the Partnerize portal has a
Resource Center
in the upper right corner. Click the light bulb.

Who do I contact for a problem with my account?

Write to
support@partnerize.com.

What products are eligible and what is the commission structure?

Adobe Creative Cloud, including Single Apps, Document Cloud, Adobe Express subscriptions and Adobe Stock are eligible.

Commission for Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, and Document Cloud Monthly plans: 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (paid monthly): 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (prepaid): 8.33% of one year subscription fee Commission for Adobe Stock

Monthly plan: US$43 Annual plan: (paid monthly): US$43 Single Purchase: (one-time payment): 8.33% 3 standard assets a month (paid monthly): 85%

Please note that Trial/Cancelled, Invalid, and Fraud orders will receive $0 commission.
Document Cloud and Adobe Stock are available only in specified countries.

Further Information:
Properly tagged deep links are critical for accurate tracking and reporting. Adobe and Partnerize are not responsible for inaccurate or broken links. Referrals made using incorrect or broken links will not be paid a commission.

Are promo codes available for Adobe affiliate marketers?

Currently only advertised promotions are available. Stay connected for more information on promo codes.

مصمم ليناسب كل من بالمراحل التعليمية.

title: برامج Adobe الأصلية | موقع Adobe الرسمي
text:
برامج Adobe الأصلية | موقع Adobe الرسمي

لتصميم أعمال مذهلة، أنت بحاجة إلى برامج Adobe الأصلية.

تتيح Adobe الإبداع للجميع. توفر لك تطبيقات Creative Cloud وخدماته العالمية ما تنشده من إبداع وأداء لتصميم أي عمل يمكنك تخيله، من أي مكان أنت فيه.

أسباب أهمية برامج Adobe الأصلية.

للأسف، لم تمنع خطوة الانتقال من البرامج المقدمة داخل العلب إلى البرامج المستندة إلى السحابة المحتالين. فهم يبحثون عن طرق لقرصنة تطبيقات Adobe الإبداعية، وبيع إصدارات مزيفة لعملاء متشكيين، ويضعون أمان الأشخاص في خطر. تعرّف على المزيد حول مزايا برامج Adobe الأصلية.

اقرأ الأسئلة المتداولة للمستخدمين

اقرأ الأسئلة المتداولة للشركات

نهتم بمنحك أفضل تجربة إبداعية على الإطلاق.

نسعى جاهدين لحمايتك من البائعين الاحتياليين وضمان توفر برامج Adobe الأصلية فقط للشراء. وبهذا تحصل على أفضل تجربة تقدمها تطبيقاتنا وخدماتنا. سنتواصل معك أيضًا لإعلامك عند امتلاك برنامج غير أصلي، وسنقدم لك الدعم والخيارات لمساعدتك على الانتقال إلى البرامج الأصلية.

تتضمن المنتجات الأصلية أحدث وسائل الأمان.

يمثل أمان بياناتك وتجاربك الرقمية أولوية بالنسبة لنا، لذا نعمل باستمرار على جعل برامجنا أكثر أمانًا ومنع النشاط الاحتيالي. وعلى عكس البرامج الأخرى، تتوفر تطبيقات Adobe الأصلية مع دعم وترقيات وأحدث وسائل الأمان من البرامج الضارة والفيروسات.

وصول مستمر إلى الابتكارات الإبداعية.

من خلال تطبيقات Adobe Creative Cloud وخدماته الأصلية فقط تحصل على ميزات جديدة وتحديثات يتم توفيرها طوال الوقت إلى برامجك مباشرةً، وبهذا يمكنك البقاء على اطلاع بأحدث الاتجاهات والأساليب الإبداعية. كما نوفر خطط تناسب الجميع - المصورون الفوتوغرافيون والطلاب وأصحاب الشركات الصغيرة وغيرهم - وبهذا يكون من السهل العثور على الخطة التي تناسب احتياجاتك.

هل تعتقد أنك تملك برامج غير أصلية؟

Frequently asked questions

What is the Adobe Affiliate Program?

The Adobe Affiliate Program is a referral program that allows you to monetize your website and social media channels by promoting Adobe products and earning a commission for each qualified sale.

How does it work?

Approved partners in the program can post banners and text links or create custom links to content that directs their visitors to the Adobe website. When that visitor makes a qualified purchase within a 30-day period, the publisher is eligible for a commission to the sale.

Is there a cost to join?

There is no fee required to sign up in the program.

Is there a minimum audience size to be approved as an Affiliate?

No. Adobe recognizes the value of partners with smaller audiences that are a great fit for Adobe.

How do I join the program?

Sign up
here.

Accept the terms and conditions to join the Partnerize network. Once you‘re on the network, request to add the Adobe campaign to your account.

Who is Partnerize and why do I need to join this Network?

Partnerize is a global platform and services provider Adobe has retained to manage the Affiliate program. Partnerize teams support and grow businesses through enablement, a content portal, tracking, dashboards, and payment of commissions.

Why can’t I add the Adobe campaign directly to my Partnerize account?

Currently, Adobe is reviewing applications for the program prior to approval.

Where do I find information on setting up my Affiliate account?

You will receive a welcome email from Partnerize with links to several support tools, including a video demo, Getting Started guide, and instructions for setting up links, payments, and more.

In addition to the tools in your Getting Started guide, the Partnerize portal has a
Resource Center
in the upper right corner. Click the light bulb.

Who do I contact for a problem with my account?

Write to
support@partnerize.com.

What products are eligible and what is the commission structure?

Adobe Creative Cloud, including Single Apps, Document Cloud, Adobe Express subscriptions and Adobe Stock are eligible.

Commission for Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, and Document Cloud Monthly plans: 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (paid monthly): 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (prepaid): 8.33% of one year subscription fee Commission for Adobe Stock

Monthly plan: US$43 Annual plan: (paid monthly): US$43 Single Purchase: (one-time payment): 8.33% 3 standard assets a month (paid monthly): 85%

Please note that Trial/Cancelled, Invalid, and Fraud orders will receive $0 commission.
Document Cloud and Adobe Stock are available only in specified countries.

Further Information:
Properly tagged deep links are critical for accurate tracking and reporting. Adobe and Partnerize are not responsible for inaccurate or broken links. Referrals made using incorrect or broken links will not be paid a commission.

Are promo codes available for Adobe affiliate marketers?

Currently only advertised promotions are available. Stay connected for more information on promo codes.

Adobe genuine software | Adobe official site

To create something genuinely amazing, you need genuine Adobe software.

Adobe enables creativity for all. Only our world-class Creative Cloud apps and services deliver the innovation and performance you need to create anything you can imagine, anywhere you are.

Why Adobe Genuine software matters.

Unfortunately, the move from boxed to cloud-based software hasn’t stopped fraudsters. They’re still finding ways to pirate Adobe’s creative apps, sell fake versions to unsuspecting customers, and potentially put people’s security at risk. Learn more about the benefits of genuine Adobe software.

Read the FAQ for End-users

Read the FAQ for Businesses

We care about giving you the best creative experience.

We strive to protect you from fraudulent sellers and ensure that only genuine Adobe software is available for purchase. That way, you’ll get the best experience from our apps and services. We’ll also reach out to inform you if you have non-genuine software, and we’ll offer support and options to help you move to genuine software.

Genuine products include the latest security protections.

The security of your data and digital experiences is our priority, so we’re constantly working to make our software safer and prevent fraudulent activity. Unlike counterfeit software, genuine Adobe apps come with support, upgrades, and the latest security protection from malware and viruses.

Ongoing access to creative innovations.

Only with genuine Adobe Creative Cloud apps and services do you get new features and updates delivered all the time, right to your software, so you can stay up to date with the latest creative trends and techniques. And we have plans for everyone — photographers, students, small business owners, and more — so it’s easy to find one that meets your needs.

Think you might have non-genuine software?

Frequently asked questions

What organizations are eligible?

To be eligible, an organization must be recognized as a charitable or nonprofit organization in the country where it is registered. For example, in the United States, a nonprofit must be an IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization or a public library. Public libraries must either have valid 501(c)(3) nonprofit status or be listed in the Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS) database.

What product offers are available?

Nonprofits can get one-year subscriptions to Adobe Acrobat Pro at a substantial discount and Adobe Express for no charge. Nonprofits can get Adobe Creative Cloud individual one-year memberships at a discount. See product offers for the cost for each product.

Access to Creative Cloud is administered through our program partner
TechSoup
.

Are these individual or team licenses?

All Adobe for Nonprofits offers available here are for individual licenses. If your organization needs more licenses or team-based access, Adobe also supports nonprofits through discounted Education Teams plans available under our VIP buying program. To learn more, visit
Adobe Buying Programs
.

Which persons affiliated with the nonprofit are eligible?

Nonprofit staff are eligible to receive Adobe for Nonprofits product offers. Nonprofit beneficiaries, members, and donors are not eligible for Adobe for Nonprofits memberships.

How can we qualify?

Individuals need to validate their nonprofit status to request each product. In the application process, you will be asked to provide the organization’s name, a valid organization email address, and a few details about your organization. Validation takes one to three business days.

Do I need to qualify for each product offer?

Yes, you must complete the validation for each product offer. Adobe is working to streamline this process in the future.

Is there a limit on the number of subscriptions my organization can request?

If your organization qualifies as an eligible entity, you can access and take advantage of the following offers:

Up to 50 Adobe Express Premium plan licenses

Up to 10 Acrobat Pro licenses

Unlimited licenses for the Adobe {{cc-all-apps-plan}} at a discounted rate

For Creative Cloud, check the detailed information on

Frequently asked questions

What is the Adobe Affiliate Program?

The Adobe Affiliate Program is a referral program that allows you to monetize your website and social media channels by promoting Adobe products and earning a commission for each qualified sale.

How does it work?

Approved partners in the program can post banners and text links or create custom links to content that directs their visitors to the Adobe website. When that visitor makes a qualified purchase within a 30-day period, the publisher is eligible for a commission to the sale.

Is there a cost to join?

There is no fee required to sign up in the program.

Is there a minimum audience size to be approved as an Affiliate?

No. Adobe recognizes the value of partners with smaller audiences that are a great fit for Adobe.

How do I join the program?

Sign up
here.

Accept the terms and conditions to join the Partnerize network. Once you‘re on the network, request to add the Adobe campaign to your account.

Who is Partnerize and why do I need to join this Network?

Partnerize is a global platform and services provider Adobe has retained to manage the Affiliate program. Partnerize teams support and grow businesses through enablement, a content portal, tracking, dashboards, and payment of commissions.

Why can’t I add the Adobe campaign directly to my Partnerize account?

Currently, Adobe is reviewing applications for the program prior to approval.

Where do I find information on setting up my Affiliate account?

You will receive a welcome email from Partnerize with links to several support tools, including a video demo, Getting Started guide, and instructions for setting up links, payments, and more.

In addition to the tools in your Getting Started guide, the Partnerize portal has a
Resource Center
in the upper right corner. Click the light bulb.

Who do I contact for a problem with my account?

Write to
support@partnerize.com.

What products are eligible and what is the commission structure?

Adobe Creative Cloud, including Single Apps, Document Cloud, Adobe Express subscriptions and Adobe Stock are eligible.

Commission for Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, and Document Cloud Monthly plans: 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (paid monthly): 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (prepaid): 8.33% of one year subscription fee Commission for Adobe Stock

Monthly plan: US$43 Annual plan: (paid monthly): US$43 Single Purchase: (one-time payment): 8.33% 3 standard assets a month (paid monthly): 85%

Please note that Trial/Cancelled, Invalid, and Fraud orders will receive $0 commission.
Document Cloud and Adobe Stock are available only in specified countries.

Further Information:
Properly tagged deep links are critical for accurate tracking and reporting. Adobe and Partnerize are not responsible for inaccurate or broken links. Referrals made using incorrect or broken links will not be paid a commission.

Are promo codes available for Adobe affiliate marketers?

Currently only advertised promotions are available. Stay connected for more information on promo codes.

Frequently asked questions

What is the Adobe Affiliate Programme?

The Adobe Affiliate Programme is a referral programme that allows you to monetise your website and social media channels by promoting Adobe products and earning a commission for each qualified sale.

How does it work?

Approved partners in the programme can post banners and text links or create customised links to content that directs their visitors to the Adobe website. When that visitor makes a qualified purchase within a 30-day period, the publisher is eligible for a commission to the sale.

Is there a cost to join?

There is no fee required to sign up in the programme.

Is there a minimum audience size to be approved as an Affiliate?

No. Adobe recognises the value of partners with smaller audiences that are a great fit for Adobe.

How do I join the programme?

Sign up
here.

Accept the terms and conditions to join the Partnerise network. Once you‘re on the network, request to add the Adobe campaign to your account.

Who is Partnerise and why do I need to join this Network?

Partnerise is a global platform and services provider Adobe has retained to manage the Affiliate programme. Partnerise teams support and grow businesses through enablement, a content portal, tracking, dashboards and payment of commissions.

Why can’t I add the Adobe campaign directly to my Partnerise account?

Currently, Adobe is reviewing applications for the programme prior to approval.

Where do I find information on setting up my Affiliate account?

You will receive a welcome email from Partnerise with links to several support tools, including a video demo, Getting Started guide and instructions for setting up links, payments and more.

In addition to the tools in your Getting Started guide, the Partnerise portal has a
Resource Centre
in the upper-right corner. Click the light bulb.

Who do I contact for a problem with my account?

Write to
support@partnerize.com.

What products are eligible and what is the commission structure?

Adobe Creative Cloud, including Single Apps, Document Cloud, Adobe Express subscriptions and Adobe Stock are eligible.

Please note that Trial/Cancelled, Invalid and Fraud orders will receive $0 commission.
Document Cloud and Adobe Stock are available only in specified countries.

Further Information:
Properly tagged deep links are critical for accurate tracking and reporting. Adobe and Partnerise are not responsible for inaccurate or broken links. Referrals made using incorrect or broken links will not be paid a commission.

Are promo codes available for Adobe affiliate marketers?

Currently only advertised promotions are available. Stay connected for more information on promo codes.

Adobe genuine software | Adobe official site

#EAEAEA

To create something genuinely amazing, you need genuine Adobe software.

Adobe enables creativity for all. Only our world-class Creative Cloud apps and services deliver the innovation and performance you need to create anything you can imagine, anywhere you are.

Why Adobe Genuine software matters.

Unfortunately, the move from boxed to cloud-based software hasn’t stopped fraudsters. They’re still finding ways to pirate Adobe’s creative apps, sell fake versions to unsuspecting customers and potentially put people’s security at risk. Learn more about the benefits of genuine Adobe software.

Read the FAQs for End-users
Read the FAQs for Businesses

We care about giving you the best creative experience.

We strive to protect you from fraudulent sellers and ensure that only genuine Adobe software is available for purchase. That way, you’ll get the best experience from our apps and services. We’ll also keep in touch to inform you if you have non-genuine software and we’ll offer support and options to help you to move to genuine software.

Genuine products include the latest security protections.

The security of your data and digital experiences is our priority, so we’re constantly working to make our software safer and prevent fraudulent activity. Unlike counterfeit software, genuine Adobe apps come with support, upgrades and the latest security protection from malware and viruses.

Ongoing access to creative innovations.

Only with genuine Adobe Creative Cloud apps and services do you get new features and updates delivered all the time, right to your software, so you can stay up to date with the latest creative trends and techniques. And we have plans for everyone — photographers, students, small business owners and more — so it’s easy to find one that meets your needs.

Think you might have an unlicensed Adobe app?

Frequently asked questions

What organizations are eligible?

To be eligible, an organization must be recognized as a charitable or nonprofit organization in the country where it is registered. For example, in the United States, a nonprofit must be an IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization or a public library. Public libraries must either have valid 501(c)(3) nonprofit status or be listed in the Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS) database.

What product offers are available?

Nonprofits can get one-year subscriptions to Adobe Acrobat Pro at a substantial discount and Adobe Express for no charge. Nonprofits can get Adobe Creative Cloud individual one-year memberships at a discount. See product offers for the cost for each product.

Access to Creative Cloud is administered through our program partner
TechSoup
.

Are these individual or team licenses?

All Adobe for Nonprofits offers available here are for individual licenses. If your organization needs more licenses or team-based access, Adobe also supports nonprofits through discounted Education Teams plans available under our VIP buying program. To learn more, visit
Adobe Buying Programs
.

Which persons affiliated with the nonprofit are eligible?

Nonprofit staff are eligible to receive Adobe for Nonprofits product offers. Nonprofit beneficiaries, members, and donors are not eligible for Adobe for Nonprofits memberships.

How can we qualify?

Individuals need to validate their nonprofit status to request each product. In the application process, you will be asked to provide the organization’s name, a valid organization email address, and a few details about your organization. Validation takes one to three business days.

Do I need to qualify for each product offer?

Yes, you must complete the validation for each product offer. Adobe is working to streamline this process in the future.

Is there a limit on the number of subscriptions my organization can request?

If your organization qualifies as an eligible entity, you can access and take advantage of the following offers:

Up to 50 Adobe Express Premium plan licenses

Up to 10 Acrobat Pro licenses

Unlimited licenses for the Adobe {{cc-all-apps-plan}} at a discounted rate

For Creative Cloud, check the detailed information on

Frequently asked questions

What is the Adobe Affiliate Program?

The Adobe Affiliate Program is a referral program that allows you to monetize your website and social media channels by promoting Adobe products and earning a commission for each qualified sale.

How does it work?

Approved partners in the program can post banners and text links or create custom links to content that directs their visitors to the Adobe website. When that visitor makes a qualified purchase within a 30-day period, the publisher is eligible for a commission to the sale.

Is there a cost to join?

There is no fee required to sign up in the program.

Is there a minimum audience size to be approved as an Affiliate?

No. Adobe recognizes the value of partners with smaller audiences that are a great fit for Adobe.

How do I join the program?

Sign up
here.

Accept the terms and conditions to join the Partnerize network. Once you‘re on the network, request to add the Adobe campaign to your account.

Who is Partnerize and why do I need to join this Network?

Partnerize is a global platform and services provider Adobe has retained to manage the Affiliate program. Partnerize teams support and grow businesses through enablement, a content portal, tracking, dashboards, and payment of commissions.

Why can’t I add the Adobe campaign directly to my Partnerize account?

Currently, Adobe is reviewing applications for the program prior to approval.

Where do I find information on setting up my Affiliate account?

You will receive a welcome email from Partnerize with links to several support tools, including a video demo, Getting Started guide, and instructions for setting up links, payments, and more.

In addition to the tools in your Getting Started guide, the Partnerize portal has a
Resource Center
in the upper right corner. Click the light bulb.

Who do I contact for a problem with my account?

Write to
support@partnerize.com.

What products are eligible and what is the commission structure?

Adobe Creative Cloud, including Single Apps, Document Cloud, Adobe Express subscriptions and Adobe Stock are eligible.

Commission for Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, and Document Cloud Monthly plans: 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (paid monthly): 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (prepaid): 8.33% of one year subscription fee Commission for Adobe Stock

Monthly plan: US$43 Annual plan: (paid monthly): US$43 Single Purchase: (one-time payment): 8.33% 3 standard assets a month (paid monthly): 85%

Please note that Trial/Cancelled, Invalid, and Fraud orders will receive $0 commission.
Document Cloud and Adobe Stock are available only in specified countries.

Further Information:
Properly tagged deep links are critical for accurate tracking and reporting. Adobe and Partnerize are not responsible for inaccurate or broken links. Referrals made using incorrect or broken links will not be paid a commission.

Are promo codes available for Adobe affiliate marketers?

Currently only advertised promotions are available. Stay connected for more information on promo codes.

Corporate Social Responsibility

Together, we create change.

Adobe has always been committed to doing the right thing by focusing on people, purpose, and community. This commitment has guided our evolution, and it inspires our employees to invent the future and change the world for the better.

Adobe for All

Adobe for All is our belief in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Our founding principle is that great ideas come from anywhere and when people are respected and included, they are more creative, innovative and successful.

Learn more about Adobe for All

Creativity for All

We live Adobe for All, so we can power Creativity for All. Everyone has a story to tell, and this drives our mission of Creativity for All. text:
Software original de Adobe | Sitio web oficial de Adobe

#EAEAEA

Para crear algo realmente original, necesitas el software original de Adobe

Adobe da rienda suelta a la creatividad de todo el mundo. Solo nuestras aplicaciones y servicios de primera categoría de Creative Cloud ofrecen la innovación y el rendimiento que necesitas para crear todo lo que se te imagines, independientemente de donde te encuentres.

Por qué es importante el software original de Adobe

Lamentablemente, el paso del software empaquetado al software en la nube no detuvo a los estafadores, que siguen encontrando formas de piratear las aplicaciones creativas de Adobe y de vender versiones falsificadas a clientes que no son conscientes de ello, lo que puede poner en riesgo la seguridad de las personas. Obtén más información sobre los beneficios del software original de Adobe.

Leer las preguntas frecuentes para usuarios finales
Leer las preguntas frecuentes para empresas

Nos preocupamos por ofrecerte la mejor experiencia creativa posible

Trabajamos para protegerte de quienes cometen fraude y garantizar que solo el software original de Adobe esté disponible para la compra. De esta manera, disfrutarás de la mejor experiencia al usar nuestras aplicaciones y servicios. Además, si tu software no es original, nos pondremos en contacto contigo para informarte y ofrecerte asistencia técnica y opciones para que puedas cambiar al original.

Los productos originales incluyen las protecciones de seguridad más recientes

La seguridad de tus datos y experiencias digitales es nuestra prioridad, por lo que estamos trabajando sin parar en reforzar la seguridad de nuestro software y evitar las actividades fraudulentas. A diferencia del software falsificado, las aplicaciones originales de Adobe incluyen asistencia técnica, actualizaciones y la última protección de seguridad contra malware y virus.

Acceso permanente a innovaciones creativas

Solo las aplicaciones y los servicios originales de Adobe Creative Cloud te ofrecen nuevas funciones y actualizaciones de forma continua, directamente en tu software, para que estés al día de las últimas tendencias y técnicas creativas. Además, contamos con planes para todo el mundo (profesionales de la fotografía, estudiantes, empresas pequeñas y mucho más), por lo que resulta fácil encontrar uno que se adapte a tus necesidades.

¿Crees que tienes una aplicación de Adobe sin licencia?

Preguntas frecuentes

¿Qué organizaciones pueden participar?

Para poder participar, una organización debe estar reconocida como organización benéfica o sin ánimo de lucro en el país donde esté registrada. Por ejemplo, en Estados Unidos, una organización sin ánimo de lucro debe ser una organización sin ánimo de lucro 501(c)(3) reconocida por el IRS o una biblioteca pública. Las bibliotecas públicas deben tener un estatus válido 501(c)(3) sin ánimo de lucro o figurar en la base de datos del Instituto de Servicios de Museos y Bibliotecas (IMLS).

¿Qué ofertas de productos hay disponibles?

Las organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro pueden obtener suscripciones de un año a Adobe Acrobat Pro con un descuento considerable y a Adobe Express sin coste alguno. Además, pueden conseguir abonos individuales de Adobe Creative Cloud con validez de un año a precio reducido. Consulta las ofertas de cada producto para conocer el coste.

El acceso a Creative Cloud se gestiona a través de nuestro partner del programa,
TechSoup
.

¿Se trata de licencias individuales o de equipo?

Todas las ofertas de Adobe para organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro aquí disponibles son para licencias individuales. Si tu organización necesita más licencias o acceso basado en equipos, Adobe también respalda a las organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro mediante planes para equipos de formación con descuento disponibles a través de nuestro programa de compras del plan VIP. Para obtener más información, visita
Programas de compra de Adobe
.

¿Qué personas afiliadas a la organización sin ánimo de lucro pueden participar?

El personal de las organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro puede recibir ofertas de productos de Adobe para organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro. Las personas beneficiarias, miembros y donantes sin ánimo de lucro no pueden optar a las suscripciones de Adobe para organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro.

¿Cómo podemos validar el estatus?

Los particulares deberán validar su estatus sin ánimo de lucro para solicitar cada producto. En el proceso de solicitud, se te pedirá que proporciones el nombre de la organización, una dirección de correo electrónico válida de la organización y algunos detalles sobre la misma. La validación tarda de uno a tres días laborables.

¿Tengo que reunir los requisitos de cada oferta de producto?

Sí, debes completar la validación para cada oferta de producto. Adobe está intentando agilizar este proceso en el futuro.

¿Hay algún límite en el número de suscripciones que puede solicitar mi organización?

Si tu organización reúne los requisitos, puedes aprovechar las siguientes ofertas:

Hasta 50 licencias del plan Adobe Express Prémium

Hasta 10 licencias de Acrobat Pro

Licencias ilimitadas para el {{cc-all-apps-plan}} de Adobe con descuento

TechSoup

Häufig gestellte Fragen

Was ist das Adobe Affiliate-Programm?

Das Adobe Affiliate-Programm ist ein Empfehlungsprogramm, mit dem du deine Website und deine Social-Media-Kanäle monetarisieren kannst, indem du Adobe-Produkte bewirbst. Dabei erhältst du für jeden qualifizierten Verkauf eine Provision.

Wie funktioniert das Programm?

Genehmigte Partnerinnen und Partner im Programm können Banner und Textlinks posten oder benutzerdefinierte Links zu Inhalten erstellen, die ihre Besucherinnen und Besucher zur Adobe-Website weiterleiten. Kommt dort innerhalb von 30 Tagen ein qualifizierter Kauf zustande, besteht ein Provisionsanspruch.

Kostet die Teilnahme etwas?

Für die Anmeldung im Programm ist keine Gebühr erforderlich.

Gibt es eine Mindestgröße für die Zielgruppe, um als Affiliate genehmigt zu werden?

Nein. Adobe erkennt den Wert von Partnerinnen und Partnern mit kleineren Zielgruppen an, die gut zu Adobe passen.

Wie nehme ich am Programm teil?

Du kannst dich
hier anmelden
.

Akzeptiere die Nutzungsbedingungen, um dem Partnerize-Netzwerk beizutreten. Sobald du im Netzwerk bist, beantrage das Hinzufügen der Adobe-Kampagne zu deinem Konto.

Was ist Partnerize und warum muss ich diesem Netzwerk beitreten?

Partnerize ist ein globaler Plattform- und Serviceanbieter, den Adobe mit der Verwaltung des Affiliate-Programms beauftragt hat. Die Partnerize-Teams unterstützen und fördern Unternehmen durch Enablement, ein Content-Portal, Tracking, Dashboards und die Auszahlung von Provisionen.

Warum kann ich die Adobe-Kampagne nicht direkt zu meinem Partnerize-Konto hinzufügen?

Derzeit prüft Adobe die Bewerbungen für das Programm vor der Genehmigung.

Wo finde ich Informationen zur Einrichtung meines Affiliate-Kontos?

Du erhältst eine Willkommens-E-Mail von Partnerize mit Links zu verschiedenen Supporttools, einschließlich einer Videodemo, eines Leitfadens für den Einstieg und Anweisungen zur Einrichtung von Links, Zahlungen und mehr.

Zusätzlich zu den Tools in deinem Leitfaden für den Einstieg verfügt das Partnerize-Portal rechts oben über ein
Resource Center
. Klicke auf die Glühbirne.

An wen wende ich mich bei Problemen mit meinem Konto?

Schreibe an
support@partnerize.com
.

Welche Produkte sind berechtigt und wie ist die Provisionsstruktur?

Adobe Creative Cloud, einschließlich Einzelanwendungen, Document Cloud, Adobe Express-Abonnements und Adobe Stock sind berechtigt.

Provision für Creative Cloud, Adobe Express und Document Cloud Monats-Abo: 85,00 % einer monatlichen Abo-Gebühr Jahres-Abo (monatlich bezahlt): 85,00 % einer monatlichen Abo-Gebühr Jahres-Abo (im Voraus bezahlt): 8,33 % einer jährlichen Abo-Gebühr Provision für Adobe Stock

Monats-Abo: 43 € Jahres-Abo: (monatlich bezahlt): 43 € Einzelkauf: (einmalige Zahlung): 8,33 % 3 Standard-Assets pro Monat (monatlich bezahlt): 85 %

Bitte beachte, dass Test-/Stornierte, ungültige und betrügerische Bestellungen 0 € Provision erhalten.
Document Cloud und Adobe Stock sind nur in bestimmten Ländern verfügbar.

Weitere Informationen:
Ordnungsgemäß getaggte Deep Links sind entscheidend für genaues Tracking und Reporting. Adobe und Partnerize sind nicht verantwortlich für ungenaue oder defekte Links. Empfehlungen mit falschen oder defekten Links erhalten keine Provision.

Sind Promo-Codes für Adobe-Affiliate-Marketer verfügbar?

Derzeit sind nur beworbene Aktionen verfügbar. Bleibe in Verbindung für weitere Informationen zu Promo-Codes.

title: Original Adobe-Software | Adobe-Website
text:
Original Adobe-Software | Adobe-Website

Original Adobe-Software: unbegrenzte Möglichkeiten ohne Risiko.

Wir bei Adobe glauben an Kreativität für alle. Durch kontinuierliche Innovationen und die Performance der Programme und Services von Creative Cloud kannst du jede Idee umsetzen. Auf jedem Gerät und an jedem Ort.

Warum es Original-Software von Adobe sein muss.

Der Umstieg von Box-Produkten auf Cloud-basierte Software hat Betrüger leider nicht aufhalten können. Nach wie vor finden sie Möglichkeiten, Kreativprogramme und Mobile Apps von Adobe zu fälschen, illegale Versionen an ahnungslose Kunden zu verkaufen und dadurch die Sicherheit von Anwenderdaten zu gefährden. Welche Vorteile Original-Software von Adobe bietet, erfährst du hier.

Häufig gestellte Fragen von Endanwendern und Endanwenderinnen

Häufig gestellte Fragen von Unternehmen

Unser Ziel: die besten Erlebnisse für Anwender bereitstellen.

Wir tun alles, um unsere Kunden vor betrügerischen Verkäufern zu schützen und sicherzustellen, dass nur Original-Software von Adobe erhältlich ist. Denn nur so können sie mit unseren Desktop-Programmen und Mobile Apps die besten Erfahrungen sammeln. Für den Fall, dass es sich bei deiner Software um eine Fälschung handelt, bieten wir Informationen und jede Unterstützung, die du brauchst, um die Nichtoriginal-Software durch eine gültige Lizenz zu ersetzen.

Original-Software verfügt über die neuesten Sicherheitsfunktionen.

Die Sicherheit deiner Daten und digitalen Kundenerlebnisse steht bei Adobe an erster Stelle. Daher arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Produkte noch sicherer zu machen und betrügerische Aktivitäten zu unterbinden. Im Gegensatz zu gefälschter Software umfasst Original-Software von Adobe Support-Leistungen, Upgrades und die neuesten Sicherheitsfunktionen zur Abwehr von Malware und Viren.

Kontinuierlicher Zugang zu Neuerungen.

Nur mit den Original-Programmen und -Services von Adobe Creative Cloud hast du jederzeit direkten Zugriff auf die neuesten Features und Updates. So bleibst du über Trends im Kreativbereich immer auf dem Laufenden. Adobe bietet Abo-Varianten für alle: ob Schüler, Studierende und Azubis, Fotografen und Fotobegeisterte oder kleine Unternehmen. So findet jeder die passende Abo-Option.

Häufig gestellte Fragen.

Welche Organisationen sind bezugsberechtigt?

Eine Organisation gilt als bezugsberechtigt, wenn sie in dem Land, in dem sie eingetragen ist, als wohltätige oder gemeinnützige Organisation anerkannt ist. In Deutschland kann dies beispielsweise an der Rechtsform der Organisation festgemacht werden: Stiftung, gemeinnütziger eingetragener Verein (im Vereinsregister als solcher eingetragen), gGmbH oder gUG (im Handelsregister eingetragen).

Welche Produktangebote gibt es für gemeinnützige Organisationen?

Gemeinnützige Organisationen erhalten einen signifikanten Rabatt auf Jahres-Abos für Adobe Acrobat Pro und können Adobe Express kostenlos verwenden. Außerdem gelten für sie günstigere Konditionen beim Erwerb von Jahres-Abos für Adobe Creative Cloud für Einzelanwenderinnen und -anwender. Die genauen Kosten der einzelnen Produkte sind den Produktangeboten zu entnehmen.

Der Zugriff auf Adobe Creative Cloud wird von unserem Programmpartner
TechSoup
verwaltet.

Handelt es sich um Einzel- oder Team-Lizenzen?

Alle hier verfügbaren Adobe-Angebote für gemeinnützige Organisationen sind Einzellizenzen. Falls eure Organisation mehr Lizenzen oder Team-basierten Zugriff benötigt, unterstützt Adobe gemeinnützige Organisationen auch durch vergünstigte Abos für Teams von Bildungseinrichtungen, die über unser Lizenzprogramm VIP erhältlich sind. Weitere Informationen findet ihr unter
Adobe-Lizenzprogramme
.

Welche zu einer gemeinnützigen Organisation gehörenden Personen sind bezugsberechtigt?

Mitarbeitende gemeinnütziger Organisationen sind berechtigt, Produktangebote von Adobe für gemeinnützige Organisationen wahrzunehmen. Unterstützte Personen sowie Mitglieder und Spendende haben keinen Anspruch auf Adobe-Produkte für gemeinnützige Organisationen.

Wie können wir unsere Bezugsberechtigung nachweisen?

Einzelpersonen müssen die Gemeinnützigkeit ihrer Organisation bei jeder Produktanfrage nachweisen. In eurem Antrag müsst ihr den Namen der Organisation, eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse dieser Organisation und einige Details über die Organisation angeben. Die Verifizierung dauert 1 bis 3 Werktage.

Müssen wir unsere Berechtigung für jedes Produktangebot einzeln nachweisen?

Ja, der Validierungsprozess muss für jedes Produktangebot durchlaufen werden. Adobe arbeitet daran, den Ablauf für die Zukunft zu vereinfachen.

Ist die Anzahl Lizenzen, die unsere Organisation beantragen kann, begrenzt?

Wenn eure Organisation bezugsberechtigt ist, stehen euch folgende Angebote zur Verfügung:

bis zu 50 Lizenzen für Adobe Express Premium

bis zu 10 Lizenzen für Acrobat Pro

unbegrenzt viele Lizenzen für das {{cc-all-apps-plan}} von Adobe zu einem ermäßigten Preis

Einzelheiten zum Creative Cloud-Angebot sind auf der Website von
TechSoup
zu finden.

Frequently asked questions

What is the Adobe Affiliate Programme?

The Adobe Affiliate Programme is a referral programme that allows you to monetise your website and social media channels by promoting Adobe products and earning a commission for each qualified sale.

How does it work?

Approved partners in the programme can post banners and text links or create customised links to content that directs their visitors to the Adobe website. When that visitor makes a qualified purchase within a 30-day period, the publisher is eligible for a commission to the sale.

Is there a cost to join?

There is no fee required to sign up in the programme.

Is there a minimum audience size to be approved as an Affiliate?

No. Adobe recognises the value of partners with smaller audiences that are a great fit for Adobe.

How do I join the programme?

Sign up
here.

Accept the terms and conditions to join the Partnerise network. Once you‘re on the network, request to add the Adobe campaign to your account.

Who is Partnerise and why do I need to join this Network?

Partnerise is a global platform and services provider Adobe has retained to manage the Affiliate programme. Partnerise teams support and grow businesses through enablement, a content portal, tracking, dashboards and payment of commissions.

Why can’t I add the Adobe campaign directly to my Partnerise account?

Currently, Adobe is reviewing applications for the programme prior to approval.

Where do I find information on setting up my Affiliate account?

You will receive a welcome email from Partnerise with links to several support tools, including a video demo, Getting Started guide and instructions for setting up links, payments and more.

In addition to the tools in your Getting Started guide, the Partnerise portal has a
Resource Centre
in the upper-right corner. Click the light bulb.

Who do I contact for a problem with my account?

Write to
support@partnerize.com.

What products are eligible and what is the commission structure?

Adobe Creative Cloud, including Single Apps, Document Cloud, Adobe Express subscriptions and Adobe Stock are eligible.

Commission for Creative Cloud, Adobe Express and Document Cloud Monthly plans: 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (paid monthly): 85.00% of one month subscription fee Annual plan (prepaid): 8.33% of one year subscription fee Commission for Adobe Stock

Monthly plan: US$43 Annual plan: (paid monthly): US$43 Single Purchase: (one-time payment): 8.33% 3 standard assets a month (paid monthly): 85%

Please note that Trial/Cancelled, Invalid and Fraud orders will receive $0 commission.
Document Cloud and Adobe Stock are available only in specified countries.

Further Information:
Properly tagged deep links are critical for accurate tracking and reporting. Adobe and Partnerise are not responsible for inaccurate or broken links. Referrals made using incorrect or broken links will not be paid a commission.

Are promo codes available for Adobe affiliate marketers?

Currently only advertised promotions are available. Stay connected for more information on promo codes.

We live Adobe for All, so we can power Creativity for All. Everyone has a story to tell and this drives our mission of Creativity for All. title: Adobe genuine software | Adobe official site
text:
Adobe genuine software | Adobe official site

#EAEAEA

To create something genuinely amazing, you need genuine Adobe software.

Adobe enables creativity for all. Only our world-class Creative Cloud apps and services deliver the innovation and performance you need to create anything you can imagine, anywhere you are.

Why Adobe Genuine software matters.

Unfortunately, the move from boxed to cloud-based software hasn’t stopped fraudsters. They’re still finding ways to pirate Adobe’s creative apps, sell fake versions to unsuspecting customers and potentially put people’s security at risk. Learn more about the benefits of genuine Adobe software.

Read the FAQs for End-users
Read the FAQs for Businesses

We care about giving you the best creative experience.

We strive to protect you from fraudulent sellers and ensure that only genuine Adobe software is available for purchase. That way, you’ll get the best experience from our apps and services. We’ll also keep in touch to inform you if you have non-genuine software and we’ll offer support and options to help you to move to genuine software.

Genuine products include the latest security protections.

The security of your data and digital experiences is our priority, so we’re constantly working to make our software safer and prevent fraudulent activity. Unlike counterfeit software, genuine Adobe apps come with support, upgrades and the latest security protection from malware and viruses.

Ongoing access to creative innovations.

Only with genuine Adobe Creative Cloud apps and services do you get new features and updates delivered all the time, right to your software, so you can stay up to date with the latest creative trends and techniques. And we have plans for everyone — photographers, students, small business owners and more — so it’s easy to find one that meets your needs.

Think you might have an unlicensed Adobe app?

Report it now | Report a website, reseller or individual distributing unlicensed Adobe products or providing instructions on how to tamper with licensed Adobe apps.

Frequently asked questions

What organizations are eligible?

To be eligible, an organization must be recognized as a charitable or nonprofit organization in the country where it is registered. For example, in the United States, a nonprofit must be an IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization or a public library. Public libraries must either have valid 501(c)(3) nonprofit status or be listed in the Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS) database.

What product offers are available?

Nonprofits can get one-year subscriptions to Adobe Acrobat Pro at a substantial discount and Adobe Express for no charge. Nonprofits can get Adobe Creative Cloud individual one-year memberships at a discount. See product offers for the cost for each product.

Access to Creative Cloud is administered through our program partner
TechSoup
.

Are these individual or team licenses?

All Adobe for Nonprofits offers available here are for individual licenses. If your organization needs more licenses or team-based access, Adobe also supports nonprofits through discounted Education Teams plans available under our VIP buying program. To learn more, visit
Adobe Buying Programs
.

Which persons affiliated with the nonprofit are eligible?

Nonprofit staff are eligible to receive Adobe for Nonprofits product offers. Nonprofit beneficiaries, members, and donors are not eligible for Adobe for Nonprofits memberships.

How can we qualify?

Individuals need to validate their nonprofit status to request each product. In the application process, you will be asked to provide the organization’s name, a valid organization email address, and a few details about your organization. Validation takes one to three business days.

Do I need to qualify for each product offer?

Yes, you must complete the validation for each product offer. Adobe is working to streamline this process in the future.

Is there a limit on the number of subscriptions my organization can request?

If your organization qualifies as an eligible entity, you can access and take advantage of the following offers:

Up to 50 Adobe Express Premium plan licenses

Up to 10 Acrobat Pro licenses

Unlimited licenses for the Adobe {{cc-all-apps-plan}} at a discounted rate

For Creative Cloud, check the detailed information on
TechSoup
.
